releaseNotes:
Hubble 1.1.13

Hubble 1.1.13: Button layout in the top navigation and reliable saved presets

Open Button layout from the top navigation immediately before Status Log. The editor is available across views and supports full-page editing, range autofill, encoder assignments, and appearance feedback installation.

Load saved layouts that include buttons beyond a physical device footprint, including extended Stream Deck Studio presets. Distinguish an unreadable preset library from an empty library without changing saved files.

Delete a saved preset through a visible confirmation dialog. Cancelling retains the preset, and deleting leaves Companion pages and the current layout draft unchanged.

Also includes improved cell formula navigation and LiveGrade Frontier support.
